fieldNotes.truckGate: Multi-lane controlled gate canopy with guard booth visible at z21 on the E-side access driveway (~40.1640,-76.8358); lane separators and barrier/gate equipment present.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small ~1-2 vehicle-footprint white booth set beside the gate lanes, distinct from the main sort building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with ample paved width; physical room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approx 2 inbound lanes through the gate canopy; exact lane split hard to read under shadow/tree cover - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Central sort building has continuous dock-door rhythm on both long faces plus a secondary NW building; total well above 50, estimated ~150 - count is approximate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Hundreds of bare trailers parked in marked rows across N, W and S of the property - clearly a dedicated drop/storage operation.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lewisberry is a small town; site sits at edge-of-town in a semi-rural light-industrial pocket with woods and a retention pond to the W - classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the gate before the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main sort building, a secondary NW dock building, plus 1-2 small ancillary structures (gatehouse, maintenance).
